## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] No credentials, local databases, logs, or personal travel data are included
- [ ] User-visible changes include screenshots or a clear description
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when needed

## Risk and rollback

Describe notification, scheduler, database, API quota, or migration risk and how
the change can be rolled back.
